observations: I opened assets/panels/03-3.png and main-cast.png with Read. Ravi is in three-quarter view just inside the glass entrance. His face matches the sheet: warm, slightly narrow eyes, thick straight brows close to the eyes, square jaw with a short trimmed beard, broad nose. He wears the light green shirt and the dark-brown shoulder bag on his left shoulder.
The hands match production. His right hand (screen-left) holds his phone up to the QR stand. His left hand, with the wristwatch on that wrist, grips the bag strap. Both hands are well formed.
The QR stand shows an abstract block pattern with no finder squares and no text, so it is not a real code. The phone shows a glowing teal scan frame around the same abstract pattern.

Background continuity: Meera at the reception desk with the monitor facing her, the TV with one blank strip, and Mr. Raman and Priya seated from behind on teal chairs. This agrees with 03-1, 03-2 and 03-5. The wall art is abstract.
Acting: focused, with an easy small smile. Plain wall at upper left for the caption.
Minor note (not blocking): Ravi's hair is fuller and more tousled than the neat side part on the sheet. His beard, brows and jaw keep him clearly identifiable.
